Anna: Heads-up — ACME asked for a short demo tomorrow (Tue 9am PT). They need confirmation on customer-managed keys, rotation with zero-downtime, and whether we can do dual-custody. Also they want a pen-test window and a rough pricing ballpark. Can SE/SEC pick this up? :eyes:
Raj: I can run the demo. Quick clarifying q: do they require HSM-backed keys (attested FIPS) or is KMS with envelope encryption sufficient? If HSM required we'll need the proxy handshake and extra lead time.
Mei: Security note — if they require split custody we need to validate custodian workflows & key ceremony plan. Please ask them to complete the security questionnaire section 3.2 (key custody) before we finalize the SOW. We also need SOC2 evidence and details on any FIPS attestation they expect.
Ben (ACME): We prefer HSM-backed CMKs and want the ability to rotate keys nightly with no app downtime. Also need a sample SOW line item and a monthly cost delta for budgeting.
Raj: Rotation model: we use alias-rollover with a grace window so existing sessions don't fail on rotate. Example we can demo: 
```yaml
key_rotation:
  strategy: alias-rollover
  grace_period: 3600   # seconds
  maintain_kv_cache: true
```
This provides effective zero-downtime for typical web flows; long-lived server TCP sessions may require rekey or reconnect.
Anna: Pricing, rough: HSM-proxy adds an ops/egress premium (~+10% on token unit cost for hosted). Dedicated/private customers take a fixed platform fee + optional HSM attestation add-on. I'll pull a quick estimate and attach to thread.
OpsBot: Docs uploaded: https://redwood.internal/docs/security/cmks-hsm-playbook — includes SOW templates, attestation checklist, and example rotation scripts.
Mei: FYI pen-test scheduling: we require a 2-week lead time post-scope sign-off, and a short scoping call to define acceptable tests and blackout windows.
Ben (ACME): Could you attach the checklist and a sample SOW line item now? Procurement wants to review by EOD Friday.
Anna: Scheduling demo for Tue 9am PT and will attach a draft SOW here. Raj/Mei — please confirm availability for that slot.
Raj: Confirmed for Tue 9am PT. I'll prepare a live rotate demo and a short slide on attestation differences (KMS vs HSM).
Mei: I'll join for the sec Q&A and walk through the checklist during the meeting.
Anna: Great — @Ben we'll DM the SOW + estimated numbers after this thread. :thumbsup:
Anna: (uploaded) https://redwood.internal/drive/sow-acme-cmks-draft.pdf
Ben (ACME): Got it, thanks. We'll start the questionnaire and aim to return it by EOD Thu.
Anna: Follow-ups for our side: 1) Raj to draft rotation demo script + slides; 2) Mei to prep the security checklist and required docs list; 3) I'll assemble pricing line items and a short SOW. I'll post updates here as they land.
